title: Test the fallback
statement: Test whatever marks an answer when the model is slow or down, because that path marks real students too.
detail:
The marking test's page marked with keyword rules when the judge failed or took over 9 s, and those rules went
untested, since the test answers were written to pass them; 9 of 91 calls got no response within 40 s and were sent
again (`g9/review/2026-10-07-archivist-marking-test/README.md`). A 3D version's fallback keeps the answer and asks the
student to send it again (`g9/review/three-film-comparison/threejs/checks.json`), and in the lesson engine an unsure or
failed judgment is not an attempt (`g9/transformer/src/glue/`).
against:
no call in that test went over the page's 9 s
limit (median 3.44 s, slowest 7.5 s).

evidence.quote: When it can't verify something, it returns nothing and the LLM evaluates as before with zero degradation.
Total evaluations | 486
Regressions | **0**
Every MCQ and MCQ_SET generation silently fell back to a legacy one-shot path.

When `_extract_stimulus_promises_llm` exhausts its retries and returns None, the detector must still flag a mismatch if the regex fast-path saw a real visual reference and no actual stimulus is present. Otherwise an LLM outage silently disables the entire mismatch detector and "Look at the chart" with no chart attached gets a free pass.
The local evaluation fallback grades free responses by keyword overlap, and a porting note propagates that defect.

**Result:** The MCQ Research step NEVER WORKED. Every MCQ and MCQ_SET generation silently fell back to a legacy one-shot path. The research was supposed to gather verified primary sources — it never ran.
